name: smartsheet
label: Smartsheet
description: Dynamic work execution platform for teams to plan, capture, manage, automate, and report on work at scale.

token.label: Access Token
token.description: In Smartsheet, open your profile picture, Personal Settings, API Access, and click Generate new access token.

add_row_to_sheet.label: Add Row to Sheet
add_row_to_sheet.description: Adds new row to a sheet.

cells.label: Cells
cells.description: Cell values by column, such as {"column_123": "Done"}: the key is column_ followed by the column ID.

location_type.label: Add Row to Top or Bottom

add_row_to_sheet.afterResponse: return { success: true, row: response.result[0], message: 'Row added successfully', cells_processed: request.body[0].cells.length };

update_row.label: Update Row

cells.label: Cells
cells.description: Cell values by column, such as {"column_123": "Done"}: the key is column_ followed by the column ID.

update_row.afterResponse: return { success: true, row: response.result[0], message: 'Row updated successfully', cells_processed: (request.body[0].cells || []).length };

attach_file_to_row.label: Attach Link to Row
attach_file_to_row.description: Adds a link attachment to a row, such as a web, Box, Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive link.

attachment_name.label: Attachment Name
attachment_name.description: Name for the attachment (optional, will use the URL if not provided)

attachment_sub_type.label: Attachment Sub Type
attachment_sub_type.description: Sub type for Google Drive and Egnyte attachments

find_rows_by_query.label: Find Row
find_rows_by_query.description: Finds rows in a specific sheet or across all accessible sheets using text queries with advanced filtering options.

search_scope.label: Search Scope
search_scope.description: Choose whether to search within a specific sheet or across all accessible sheets.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Text to search for. Use double quotes for exact phrase matching (e.g., "project status")

search_scopes.label: Search Scopes
search_scopes.description: Specify what types of content to search in (leave empty to search all), as a list such as ["cellData", "comments"]

include_favorites.label: Include Favorite Flags
include_favorites.description: Include information about which items are marked as favorites

modified_since.label: Modified Since
modified_since.description: Only return results modified on or after this date/time, such as 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z

max_results.label: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100)

object_types_filter.label: Filter by Object Types
object_types_filter.description: Only return results of specific object types (leave empty for all types), as a list such as ["row"]

find_attachment_by_row_id.label: List Row Attachments
find_attachment_by_row_id.description: Lists the attachments of a row, including those of its comments, with paging and filters.

include_all.label: Include All Results
include_all.description: If true, include all results without pagination (overrides page and page size)

page.label: Page Number
page.description: Which page to return (defaults to 1, ignored if "Include All Results" is true)

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (defaults to 100, max 10000, ignored if "Include All Results" is true)

attachment_type_filter.label: Filter by Attachment Type
attachment_type_filter.description: Only return attachments of specific types (leave empty for all types), as a list such as ["FILE"]

parent_type_filter.label: Filter by Parent Type
parent_type_filter.description: Only return attachments from specific parent types (leave empty for all), as a list such as ["ROW"]

min_file_size_kb.label: Minimum File Size (KB)
min_file_size_kb.description: Only return files with size greater than or equal to this value (applies to FILE type only)

max_file_size_kb.label: Maximum File Size (KB)
max_file_size_kb.description: Only return files with size less than or equal to this value (applies to FILE type only)

find_sheet_by_name.label: Find Sheet(s)
find_sheet_by_name.description: Finds the sheets that match the given filters.

sheet_name.label: Sheet Name Filter
sheet_name.description: Filter sheets by name (partial or exact match). Leave empty to list all sheets.

exact_match.label: Exact Name Match
exact_match.description: When filtering by name, require exact match instead of partial match

include_all.label: Include All Results
include_all.description: If true, include all results without pagination (overrides page and page size)

page.label: Page Number
page.description: Which page to return (defaults to 1, ignored if "Include All Results" is true)

page_size.label: Page Size
page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (defaults to 100, max 10000, ignored if "Include All Results" is true)

access_api_level.label: Access API Level
access_api_level.description: API access level for viewing and filtering permissions

access_level_filter.label: Filter by Access Level
access_level_filter.description: Only return sheets where you have specific access levels (leave empty for all), as a list such as ["OWNER"]

modified_since.label: Modified Since
modified_since.description: Only return sheets modified on or after this date/time, such as 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z

include_sheet_version.label: Include Sheet Version
include_sheet_version.description: Include current version number of each sheet

include_source_info.label: Include Source Information
include_source_info.description: Include information about the source (template/sheet) each sheet was created from

numeric_dates.label: Numeric Dates
numeric_dates.description: Return dates as milliseconds since UNIX epoch instead of ISO strings

created_date_range.label: Created Date Range
created_date_range.description: Filter sheets by creation date range

sort_by.label: Sort Results By
sort_by.description: How to sort the returned sheets

new_row_added.label: New Row Added
new_row_added.description: Triggers when a new row is added.

webhook.beforeRequest:
if (!inputs.sheet_id) throw new Error('Sheet ID is required to enable the webhook.');
return request;
webhook.reply:
// Smartsheet checks the address by sending a challenge, which it expects back.
return response !== null && typeof response === 'object' && 'challenge' in response ? { smartsheetHookResponse: response.challenge } : null;
